story: I'm Farhan — founder of Taryx Labs. I'm from Bangladesh, now based in Lithuania, where I'm completing my bachelor's in Programming and Multimedia.
I started Taryx Labs to build websites that combine premium design with practical AI — like the assistant on this page that can answer your questions right now.
Our goal is simple: help businesses look exceptional online and save time with smart technology.

projects.title: Aurelia Estates
projects.description: A real estate website where visitors filter homes, book viewings, and chat with an AI assistant that recommends properties from the live listings.

case.challenge: Real estate agencies lose leads after hours — visitors have questions about price, size and availability, but nobody is there to answer, and browsing long listing pages is slow.
case.solution: A clean property website with instant filters and an AI assistant that knows every listing. It answers questions in plain language, recommends matching homes and guides visitors to book a viewing.
features: AI assistant trained on live listings
Instant filters: buy/rent, type, bedrooms, budget
Viewing booking with date & time picker
Works offline with smart built-in answers
results: Visitors find a matching home in seconds
Every conversation can end in a booking

projects.title: CaptionCraft
projects.description: Describe a post and get three scroll-stopping captions plus hashtags, with a live Instagram-style preview and one-click copy.

case.challenge: Small business owners know they should post every day, but writing good captions takes time and creativity they don't have.
case.solution: A focused tool: describe the business and the post, pick a tone and platform, and AI writes three ready-to-use captions with hashtags — previewed exactly as they'll look on a phone.
features: Live phone preview of the post
Structured AI output for reliable results
results: A week of captions in minutes

projects.title: BrandKit AI
projects.description: Type a business idea and AI designs a color palette, font pairing, tagline and brand voice — then previews it on a live website mockup.

case.challenge: New businesses need a brand before they can build anything — but hiring a designer is expensive and slow, and DIY results look generic.
case.solution: Describe the business and its vibe, and AI creates a complete starter identity: a balanced 5-color palette, a font pairing, a tagline and a brand voice — shown live on a website preview.
features: Tagline, brand voice and logo idea
Instant website mockup in the new brand
Click any color to copy its code
results: A brand direction in under a minute
Ready to hand to a developer
